meta.title: Driver ESG Report — Complete Implementation (ISO 26000 / CSRD)
meta.description: Full feature addition to TruckNet. Adds data collection for everything the company needs to report under CSRD + ISO 26000, then exports a structured PDF + CSV that HR uploads directly into the ESG/RSE platform for automatic observation extraction. Zero manual data entry on the ESG side.

csrd_coverage_target.ESRS_E1: GHG Scope 1 (direct fleet emissions) + Scope 2 (electric vehicles if applicable) + energy intensity
csrd_coverage_target.ESRS_E5: Fuel consumption, energy use per km, empty run ratio
csrd_coverage_target.ESRS_S1: Working hours, overtime, rest periods, accident frequency rate, training hours, certifications
csrd_coverage_target.ESRS_S1_diversity: Gender, age group, contract type per driver
csrd_coverage_target.ESRS_G1: Compliance incidents, regulatory stops, maintenance record

what_this_adds_to_trucknet: Shift log — driver start/end shift, breaks, overtime (new data collection)
Vehicle maintenance log — service records, inspections, fuel fills (new data collection)
Driver training & certification tracker — courses, licenses, expiry dates (new data collection)
Driver diversity profile — gender, age group, contract type (new data collection)
Empty run tracker — return trips with no cargo (enhancement to existing trip model)
Fleet ESG benchmark card — driver vs fleet average on PDF cover (new report section)
Automated quarterly report scheduler — auto-generate + email HR (new background job)
Structured PDF/CSV export optimised for ESG platform OCR extraction (existing FEAT-008 base)
meta.esg_platform_ocr_guarantee: Section 6 of every PDF contains a clean two-column structured table with exact ESG platform normalized_key strings as visible text labels. PaddleOCR + Grok extract observations on first pass with zero ambiguity.

subagents.name: Foundation Agent
subagents.title: DB schema — all new tables + updated existing tables + Zod schemas
subagents.description: All new tables needed to collect the missing data. Minimal changes to existing tables. All PKs UUIDv7, all tables include company_id for RLS.

tasks.action: APPEND all new tables + MODIFY existing transport_trips table

ADD COLUMN: load_factor_pct real('load_factor_pct')  — cargo weight / max payload × 100; nullable

new_tables.name: driver_profiles
new_tables.description: Extended driver diversity + HR profile. Separate from the core drivers table to keep sensitive data isolated. One-to-one with drivers.
columns: driver_id: uuid FK → drivers CASCADE UNIQUE
birth_year: integer nullable  — year only, no full DOB for GDPR
contract_end_date: date nullable  — null for CDI
weekly_hours_contractual: real nullable  — contractual hours per week

new_tables.name: driver_shifts
new_tables.description: Shift log — records actual working time per day per driver. Enables ESRS S1 working hours, overtime, rest period compliance.
columns: trip_id: uuid FK → transport_trips nullable  — linked trip if applicable
ended_at: timestamp with timezone nullable  — null while shift active
break_minutes: integer notNull default 0  — total break time in minutes
driving_minutes: integer nullable  — computed: (ended_at - started_at) - break_minutes
overtime_minutes: integer notNull default 0  — minutes beyond contractual daily hours
night_shift: boolean notNull default false  — shift contains hours between 22h and 6h

new_tables.name: vehicle_maintenance_logs
new_tables.description: Vehicle service and maintenance records. Enables ESRS E5 (resource use) and G1 (regulatory compliance). One vehicle = one driver for fleet trucks.
columns: driver_id: uuid FK → drivers nullable  — which driver's vehicle
odometer_km: real nullable  — odometer reading at service
fuel_liters: real nullable  — for fuel_fill type only
fuel_type: fuelTypeEnum nullable  — for fuel_fill type
provider_name: varchar(200) nullable  — garage or service center name
next_due_at: date nullable  — next scheduled maintenance date
next_due_km: real nullable  — next maintenance at odometer km
regulatory_compliant: boolean notNull default true  — passed inspection / meets regulation
document_url: varchar(500) nullable  — invoice or certificate stored in R2

new_tables.name: driver_training_records
new_tables.description: Training and certification records per driver. Enables ESRS S1 training hours and ISO 26000 §6.4.7 human development. Also tracks license renewals.
columns: title: varchar(200) notNull  — e.g. 'Formation éco-conduite ADEME', 'Renouvellement permis CE'
provider: varchar(200) nullable  — training organization name
duration_hours: real notNull  — training duration in hours
expiry_date: date nullable  — for certifications with expiry
document_url: varchar(500) nullable  — certificate stored in R2

new_tables.name: driver_esg_reports
new_tables.description: Compiled ESG report record. References all source data and output files.
columns: total_shift_hours: real notNull default 0  — from driver_shifts
expiring_certifications_count: integer notNull default 0  — expiring within 90 days
status: varchar(20) notNull default 'generating'  — generating | ready | failed

new_tables.name: esg_report_schedules
new_tables.description: Automated report generation schedules. When a schedule fires, it generates reports for all active drivers.
columns: hr_email: varchar(300) notNull  — email to send completed reports
next_run_at: date notNull  — computed on creation and after each run

subagents.name: Data Aggregator Agent
subagents.title: lib/driver-esg-aggregator.ts — build complete EsgDataPackage
subagents.description: Query all TruckNet tables for a driver + period and produce the structured EsgDataPackage. Single source of truth before rendering. All calculations documented with their CSRD/ISO reference.

identity: gender (from driver_profiles — for diversity reporting ESRS S1)
transport_activity: total_trips: number  — completed trips in period
empty_run_pct: number  — ESRS E1: empty running increases GHG intensity
avg_load_factor_pct: number  — average cargo fill rate
trips: TripSummary[]  — one per trip with all fields
working_time: total_driving_hours: number  — sum of trip durations
total_overtime_hours: number  — ESRS S1: overtime monitoring
night_shift_count: number  — ESRS S1: night work indicator
rest_compliance_pct: number  — % of days with adequate rest (≥11h between shifts, EU regulation 561/2006)
note: 'Calcul conformément au règlement européen 561/2006 sur les temps de conduite'
ghg_emissions: ghg_scope1_kgco2eq: number  — direct emissions from company-owned vehicles
ghg_scope1_loaded_kgco2eq: number  — GHG on loaded trips only
ghg_scope1_empty_kgco2eq: number  — GHG on empty runs (waste emissions)
ghg_intensity_per_tonne_km: number  — kg CO2eq / (tonne × km); null if no cargo weight data
fuel_from_maintenance: number  — fuel recorded in maintenance fuel_fill logs
note: 'GHG calculé selon ADEME Base Carbone 2024. Scope 1 = véhicules appartenant ou loués à l\'entreprise.'
vehicle_maintenance: maintenance_count: number  — total service events in period
total_maintenance_cost_eur: number  — nullable if costs not entered
training_certifications: training_hours_total: number  — ESRS S1 training indicator
certifications_expiring_90d: number  — expiring within 90 days of period_end
diversity: note: 'Données individuelles. Agréger sur la flotte pour les indicateurs diversité CSRD.'
fleet_benchmark: fleet_avg_ghg_intensity_per_km: number  — company average for comparison

calculations.ghg_intensity_per_tonne_km: ghg_scope1 / SUM(cargo_weight_kg/1000 × distance_km per trip) — null if any trip missing cargo_weight
calculations.rest_compliance: For each consecutive pair of shifts: gap = shift2.started_at - shift1.ended_at. Compliant if gap >= 11 hours (EU Reg 561/2006). rest_compliance_pct = compliant_days / total_shift_days × 100
calculations.fleet_benchmarks: Run same aggregation across ALL drivers in company for same period, then compute averages. Exclude the current driver from fleet average.

subagents.name: CSV + Scheduler Agent
subagents.title: CSV exporter + automated quarterly scheduler
subagents.description: CSV structured for ESG platform bulk import + BullMQ cron job that auto-generates reports on schedule.

notes: One row per KPI in EsgDataPackage
Null values exported as empty string — never 'null' or 'N/A'

steps: 1. Load driverEsgReports record (get driver_id, period, language)
6. UPDATE driverEsgReports: status='ready', all KPI fields, generated_at=NOW()
8. If report was triggered by schedule: send email to schedule.hr_email with PDF + CSV download links
On error: status='failed', error_message, retry once after 2 minutes

tasks.description: BullMQ cron job. Runs daily at 06:00. Checks esg_report_schedules for entries where next_run_at <= today AND active=true. For each matching schedule, generates one report per active driver for the completed period. Updates next_run_at to next period end.

period_calculation.monthly: period = previous calendar month. next_run_at = last day of current month.
period_calculation.quarterly: period = previous calendar quarter (Q1=Jan-Mar, Q2=Apr-Jun, Q3=Jul-Sep, Q4=Oct-Dec). next_run_at = last day of current quarter.

tasks.email: Send email via existing email provider (nodemailer or Resend). Subject: 'Rapports ESG conducteurs — [period] — [company_name]'. Body: list of drivers with PDF + CSV download links. Attach fleet summary CSV.

subagents.name: API Agent
subagents.title: All new REST routes
subagents.description: All routes required for the new data collection forms + report generation. company_id always from session.
key_routes: POST /api/drivers/[driverId]/shifts/[shiftId]/complete — end shift (body: CompleteShiftSchema). Computes driving_minutes = (ended_at - started_at) - break_minutes
POST /api/drivers/[driverId]/maintenance — log maintenance event (body: CreateMaintenanceSchema). If maintenance_type='fuel_fill': also updates running fuel total on driver record
GET  /api/drivers/[driverId]/training — list training records + expiry alerts
GET  /api/drivers/esg-reports — list all reports for company
